v.deps: Frontend adaptation (EP-57014, Visitor team) had to ship with it: the change is breaking (old view/day body now answers 400), the calendar was broken on alpha until the adapted frontend reached rc on 23 Sep, and pushes to alpha/rc/prod had to be agreed with the frontend developer. Sub-tasks EP-57262 (contract), EP-57263 (build, PR 5089), EP-57264 and EP-57391 (QA). Mobile is not a consumer: Android and iOS calendars are native and call no API for it. Open risks carried: 4 performance cases blocked because the EP-57286 test stand is gone with no one named to replace it; id-list validation defect EP-57367 filed separately across all search endpoints.
v.impact: Platform & Attendees: eliminates rendering lag and multiple round trips during multi-day calendar navigation. Engineering & QA: clean OpenAPI contract with standardized envelope and server-side timezone boundary resolution.
v.notes: 17 Sep: QA complete on 154 cases with no failures, but 15 cases not executed (performance, planner, timezone, null-start) and none human-verified; four documentation corrections owed, JD-15 fixed in the Description the same day. 17 Sep: Android and iOS confirmed native, not calling these endpoints. Jira: Done, resolved 23 Sep.
v.rationale: Re-architects session search endpoints (/sessionsCalendarView and /sessionsDates) to replace inefficient single-day/week queries with an inclusive, bounded date-range (dayFrom..dayTo up to 31 days) and a single unpaginated date picker fetch.
v.why: API behind the new multi-day session calendar (split from EP-57014): day-range sessions and a days-with-sessions list in one call each.
